description: Charavane Waterfall Have you ever dream of a place untouched by the hustle and bustle of city life? A place where lush green forests, milky waterfalls, and gushing rivers come together to create a mesmerizing natural haven? Look no further than Charavane Waterfalls, also known as Agadacho Waterfall, hidden in the picturesque village of Charavane in Sattari Taluka, North Goa. CHARAVANE WATERFALLS LOCATION Charavane Waterfall, located in Goa, is a hidden gem nestled in the dense jungles of Charavane village, approximately 12 kilometers from Valpoi City. This undiscovered delight offers visitors a chance to immerse themselves in the lush beauty of nature. The waterfall requires a trek of close to 1.5 kilometers upwards, leading to a viewing place near the fall that provides the perfect spot to enjoy the serene environment The waterfall is situated in the region of the Mhadei Wildlife Sanctuary, offering breathtaking views of the lush green forest along with the gushing flow of the river. It is located 57 kilometers from Panaji via Amona bridge and 71.1 kilometers from Dabolim Airport via Borim-Belgaum highway to Usgao CHARAVANE Charavane Waterfalls is especially popular among trekkers and adventure enthusiasts, offering a trekking trail through beautiful scenic locales. The village people of Charavane are known for their kindness and friendliness, often guiding tourists up to the waterfalls. This spot is an excellent place to visit with friends and family, providing a peaceful retreat into nature CHARAVANE WATERFALL GOA - A SERENE ESCAPE AMIDST NATURE'S BOUNTY Located just 57 km from Panaji and 59.7 km from Margao, Charavane Waterfalls stands at the base of the magnificent Chorla Ghat. As you approach the viewing area at the foot of the hill, you'll be treated to a breathtaking sight of numerous falls cascading in harmony. Each waterfall has its own unique beauty, tucked away like a precious gem in the forest's lap. HIDDEN GEM Often referred to as one of North Goa's most stunning waterfalls, Charavane is considered a hidden gem yet to be explored by many tourists. Its secluded location in a small village contributes to its charm and tranquility, making it an ideal spot for those looking to escape the more crowded tourist spots in Goa TREKKING ADVENTURE For adventure enthusiasts, Charavane Waterfalls offers an exciting trekking opportunity. The trek takes you through fields, slippery rocks, and small streams, with dense shrubs and veils embracing your path. The trail, spanning approximately 1 to 1.5 kilometers, rewards you with a spectacular view of the waterfalls as you ascend the hill. The journey is as rewarding as the destination, with each step bringing you closer to nature's wonders. WARMTH OF THE VILLAGE Charavane village, situated around 12 km from Valpoi city, exudes the warmth and hospitality of its people. The friendly locals willingly guide and assist tourists on their way to the waterfalls, sharing their love for this enchanting place. PRESERVING NATURE'S GIFT Charavane Waterfalls is situated in the region of Mhadei Wildlife Sanctuary, which ensures the conservation of its diverse flora and fauna. As you explore the falls, you become a part of the effort to preserve this pristine natural wonder for generations to come. A SOLACE AMIDST NATURE'S EMBRACE Charavane Waterfalls, with its unmatchable beauty and tranquil environment, offers a soothing retreat away from the city's chaos. It's a place where you can bask in the lap of nature, listen to the symphony of the waterfalls, and reconnect with your inner self. Next time you plan a trip to Goa, don't miss the opportunity to discover Charavane Waterfalls, a hidden treasure waiting to be explored. It's a destination that reminds us of the beauty and power of untouched nature, where every step leads to a new revelation and every sight leaves us in awe. So, pack your bags, put on your trekking shoes, and set off on an unforgettable journey to Charavane Waterfalls. Embrace nature's bounty, and let this mesmerizing oasis leave an indelible mark on your heart and soul.

The best time to visit Charavane Waterfall is during the monsoon season (July to September). The waterfalls are at their fullest during this time and the surrounding forest is lush and green. However, it is important to note that the trails can be slippery during the monsoon season.
The waterfalls are open all year round, but they may be closed during the monsoon season due to flooding. It is always a good idea to check the weather forecast before visiting.
The entrance to Charavane Waterfall is free. However, there is a parking fee of ₹ 50 for cars and ₹ 20 for motorcycles.
The trek to the waterfalls is about 2 kilometers long and takes about 45 minutes to an hour. The trail is well-maintained and easy to follow. However, it is important to wear sturdy shoes as the trail can be rocky in some places.
There is no swimming allowed in the waterfalls. The water is very cold and there are strong currents.
Be respectful of the wildlife in the area. The Mhadei Wildlife Sanctuary is home to a variety of animals, including elephants, leopards, and monkeys. Do not feed or disturb the animals.
Carry plenty of water and snacks with you. There are no food or beverage stalls near the waterfalls.
Pack sunscreen and insect repellent. The weather can be hot and humid in Goa, so it is important to protect yourself from the sun and insects.
Leave no trace. Take your trash with you and do not litter in the area.
